args.script:
cat << 'EOF' > count.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Count all directories inside problem_directory (excluding problem_directory itself)
dir_count=$(find problem_directory -type d -mindepth 1 | wc -l)

# Count all files inside problem_directory
file_count=$(find problem_directory -type f | wc -l)

# Sum
total=$((dir_count + file_count))

echo "$total"
EOF
chmod +x count.sh
./count.sh
